jobs.title: Data Scientist - E2
jobs.description: Standard Job Description Perform modeling, simulation & analysis in support of the F-35 Sustainment program and will be responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the data scientist draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. The selected candidate should have the ability to perform analysis via multi-criteria decision modeling including statistical & risk analysis, life-cycle cost analysis, performance & cost trade-offs, and business case analysis. They should have a foundational understanding of a broad set of tools to be able to apply the right tool to each data exploration activity. The selected candidate will be responsible to: Utilize modeling & simulation technical principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to conduct supportability and performance based logistics metrics assessments using commercial, government, and LM developed tools. Work under the guidance of a technical lead to implement improved Sustainment modeling & analysis capabilities in several areas. Analyze F-35 fielded performance developing solutions to assigned problems for the purpose of forecasting, root cause analysis, evaluation of potential solutions, and assessment of corrective actions. Experience with the construction and execution of data models and discrete event simulators. Experience with quantitative and qualitative data collection, data cleaning and management. Experience with converting data artifacts into visualizations utilizing Tableau. Comfortable working in "big data" environments (downloading, uploading, aggregating, etc). Basic Qualifications Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or related technical discipline (Industrial, Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, etc), Physics, Data Science, Data Analysis, Physics, or Mathematics (use of stochastic and deterministic data models) or related technical disciplines with an emphasis in modeling, data manipulation, and/or the application of mathematical and statistical methods to business problems.. Experience in descriptive and predictive modeling, prescriptive modeling, and/or optimization. AI/Machine learning Programming experience with Python or other high-level language. Experience with distributed databases and with large datasets Strong data visualization skills and proficiency with statistical analysis Desired Skills Advanced statistics and statistical modeling Prescriptive analytics Time series analysis and forecasting Languages: R, SAS, Python, MATLAB, SQL, Alteryx, Tableau Experience with continuous improvement opportunities Ability to interact with the customer as the subject matter expert to present and work through data issues and discrepancies Knowledge of the SAFe agile framework environment and in a product owner support role Ability to define technical solutions against business opportunities Experience with application of scientific methods for testing and debugging, problem resolution, root-cause analysis. Experience deconstructing complex operations into component data problems for distributed work across teams. Experienced in data structures and hierarchies Experience collecting and compiling datasets from disparate data sources into the required data structure. Proficiency with MS Office tool suite. Experience managing data quality and configuration control. Experience analyzing supply chain networks. Analytical skills and understanding of system databases, data elements and application software solutions to optimize data gathering and analysis. Pay Information Full-Time Salary Range: $81100.00 - $150500.00 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally. The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer. Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability. Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics. For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: Associate Data Engineer
jobs.description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. Position Summary As a member of the EVA data engineering team at Optum Technology, you will transform EVA usage data into meaningful analyses and actionable insights. Leveraging Google Cloud Data Fusion and modern data platform capabilities, you will contribute to building and maintaining reliable data pipelines that process usage metrics to support data-driven decision-making across the enterprise. In this remote role, you will collaborate with cross-functional technical teams to design efficient data integration workflows, automate data processing, and leverage modern tools to continuously improve our data assets. You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. Primary Responsibilities Transform EVA usage data into structured datasets and meaningful analytical outputs using Google Cloud Data Fusion Assist in designing, building, and maintaining robust data integration workflows and ETL/ELT pipelines Use enterprise-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate data engineering tasks, and drive continuous process improvement Assist in designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered data solutions to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible AI usage Evaluate emerging technology trends to inform solution design, pipeline optimization, and strategic innovation Write clean, efficient SQL queries and data transformation scripts to support analytics and operational reporting Monitor daily data processing workflows, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and perform data profiling to ensure data quality and accuracy Document data pipeline workflows, data mapping specifications, and system architectures for team reference You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. Required Qualifications High School Diploma/GED 1+ years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, or software development 1+ years of experience working with relational databases and writing SQL queries 1+ years of experience with programming or scripting languages (e.g., Python, Scala, or Java) for data processing Foundational knowledge of ETL/ELT pipeline concepts, data transformation techniques, and data warehousing principles Willingness and ability to learn and build data pipelines using Google Cloud Data Fusion (prior experience with Google Cloud Data Fusion is not required) Demonstrated ability to analyze, profile, and troubleshoot data quality or pipeline performance issues Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field Prior experience with or exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, including Google Cloud Data Fusion or BigQuery Experience or familiarity with utilizing AI-assisted development tools to optimize daily workflows and data pipeline creation Exposure to cloud data platform architectures and cloud-native data integration tools Knowledge of workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) or big data processing frameworks Familiarity with DevOps principles, CI/CD deployment pipelines, and version control tools (e.g., Git) All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $60,200 to $107,400 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission. UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. UnitedHealth Group is a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment. #RPO #GREEN

jobs.title: Founding Data Engineer
jobs.description: Founding Engineer | San Francisco (Onsite) | $165K–$190K base We've partnered with an AI-native startup rebuilding how one of the world's largest and least-digitised supply chains actually runs: the multi-trillion-dollar market for electronic components. Their platform brings modern pricing intelligence and automation to distributors who are still running decades-old ERP systems, some installed back in the 90s. They are already live in production with top-tier independent distributors processing hundreds of millions in transactions a year, and growth is accelerating largely through word of mouth. The company is backed by a $3M+ seed round led by Wischoff Ventures, with Liquid 2, Stage 2, Rebellion VC and Entrepreneur First also on the cap table. The founding team pairs deep manufacturing and industry expertise with serious technical pedigree: the CTO was the first AI hire at an a16z-backed startup, and the co-founder has scaled a business from early revenue into the tens of millions. This is a rare opportunity to join as one of the first engineers and own entire product streams from your first week. You will work directly with the CTO in a flat, fast-moving team, ship features straight to real customers, and build the data infrastructure that the whole product runs on. It comes with meaningful early-stage equity and a clear path to leading your own engineering team as the company scales. If you want real ownership, direct customer contact, and the intensity of a small team building something big in a legacy industry ripe for change, this is it. The Role As a Founding Engineer, you will: Build and harden robust data pipelines that process live production data from legacy ERP systems for distributors turning over hundreds of millions a year. Own a product stream end to end, from customer conversations to shipped features, within your first couple of weeks. Deploy and customise data ingestion tooling across multiple customers, each with different file formats, ERPs and integration requirements. Talk directly with non-technical customers to learn the industry and gather requirements, translating what you hear into what you build. Contribute to AI agent development as the data layer matures, including voice applications and agent-based data ingestion. About You You have 2 to 5 years of engineering experience, with meaningful time spent in a startup. This is a founding hire, so we are not able to consider new graduates. You are a strong generalist who is comfortable across SQL, Python and TypeScript, and you enjoy building and maintaining production data pipelines. You are a clear, concise communicator. A lot of this job is explaining technical work to operators who have run their businesses for decades and have no interest in your stack. The first stage is a 20 minute conversation with the CTO, and it rewards people who get to the point. You have a genuinely competitive streak with something to show for it. Sport at a serious level, competitive programming, chess, music to a high grade, anything where you have been measured against other people and cared about the result. One of these backgrounds fits you: a generalist or data-focused engineer from a fast-moving startup, a standout builder with a strong open-source or side-project portfolio, or an engineer with a high-bar company on their CV who wants far more ownership. Nice to have: exposure to voice or agent-based data ingestion. You are based in or ready to relocate to San Francisco and happy to work onsite five days a week. Visa sponsorship is available, including OPT and H1B transfers and a J1 to O1 conversion path. US-based candidates are preferred, with strong UK-based candidates also considered. The process runs to four stages and ends with a paid day-long work trial, so you see the real work before committing. The team is moving quickly with this hire. If you're interested in being a founding engineer bringing AI to a multi-trillion-dollar supply chain still run on legacy systems, apply now or send your CV directly to will@inventurerecruitment.com.

jobs.title: ML/AI Engineer – Consultant
jobs.description: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. Your Role And Responsibilities As a Data Engineer with expertise in Machine Learning, you build reliable, well-engineered software that applies machine learning and modern AI techniques to real business problems. You take well-defined tasks and features and deliver them correctly, on time, and to a standard others can build on. using modern AI tooling to work faster without cutting corners on quality. Build ML/AI components: implement models, features, and application logic against clear specifications, choosing appropriate methods from established approaches. Engineer for quality: write clean, readable, tested code; use version control, code review, and the team's standards as a matter of habit. Get the details right and verify your own work against acceptance criteria before it's called done. Evaluate & validate: measure model/solution performance with the right metrics and confirm outputs are correct, and not just that the code runs. Accelerate with modern AI: use LLM/agentic tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to move faster, while reviewing and validating everything the AI produces. Communicate: clearly present your results and progress to the team; flag blockers and slippage early. Bridge Business and Technology: Translate requirements, evaluate against business metrics This job can be performed from anywhere in the US. Preferred Education Master's Degree Required Technical And Professional Expertise Applied ML/AI foundations: working knowledge of core ML concepts and common frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow); able to apply them to defined problems. Data fluency: able to work with data, interpret results, and identify relevant features. Detail & execution: a track record of delivering assigned work reliably and accurately. Data Analysis Skills: Ability to interpret statistical data and identify relevant features to inform solution development. Modern AI tooling: exposure to LLM/agentic developer tools and prompt basics. Use Claude, Copilot, LLM agents for acceleration Solid software engineering: proficiency in Python (or similar); comfortable with version control, testing, and code review. You care about correctness and readable, maintainable code. Communication & business awareness: explains technical work clearly to teammates and non-experts, and is starting to connect the “why” (business need) to the “how” (technical solution).

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst

If you enjoy digging into data, building dashboards and reporting solutions, solving complex problems, and working directly with business teams to understand what they actually need—not simply what they ask for—this could be a great opportunity. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy , helping teams across GVTC access and understand the information they need to make informed decisions. You'll work with technologies including Power BI, SQL, Python, data warehouses, ETL processes, and enterprise business applications while having the opportunity to take ownership of solutions from initial requirements through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. What You'll DoBusiness Intelligence & Analytics Partner with teams across GVTC to understand reporting, analytics, and decision-support needs Translate business requirements into scalable business intelligence solutions Design, develop, test, and deploy dashboards, reports, and analytical applications Use historical and operational data to uncover insights and support strategic decision-making Create project plans, requirements documentation, design documents, test plans, and test cases Estimate the effort required for assigned projects and requests Manage priorities and deliver work according to approved project timelines Communicate system enhancements, changes, and scheduled upgrades to users Develop technical documentation, user guides, and training materials Provide regular project and request status updates to stakeholders and management Follow established application development, SDLC, technical support, and change-control processes What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable analyzing a dataset, troubleshooting a technical issue, and sitting down with a business partner to understand the problem they're trying to solve. Successful candidates will bring: Associate or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field 3+ years of relevant professional experience Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Working knowledge of database design and development concepts Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and Transact-SQL Experience with stored procedures, triggers, and related database functionality Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio Experience with Power BI Working knowledge of Python or another machine-learning system Familiarity with Microsoft Visual Studio Hands-on technical troubleshooting experience Understanding of business systems principles Knowledge of applicable data privacy practices and requirements Strong written and verbal communication skills Telecommunications industry experience is preferred but not required. Additional Experience We'd Value Experience with any of the following would be a plus: Microsoft .NET Framework MicroStrategy SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) Object-oriented analysis and design principles Microsoft Office You don't need to check every preferred-technology box to be successful in this role. How You'll Work Strong technical skills matter, but so does the way you approach problems and work with others. You'll thrive in this position if you are: Curious and willing to learn new technologies Highly analytical and detail-oriented Self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of your work Able to prioritize competing projects and requests Comfortable working independently and collaboratively Able to translate technical concepts into language business users can understand Focused on both accuracy and usability Comfortable asking questions and digging deeper to understand the real business need behind a request Compensation & Work Environment Salary: $72,315–$100,000 per year Additional Compensation: Bonus opportunities Performance bonus Work Location: Hybrid in New Braunfels, TX 78132 This position requires three days per week in the office , with the remaining schedule eligible for remote work. Occasional overtime may be required to meet project deadlines. Why GVTC? For more than 75 years, GVTC has served communities across the Texas Hill Country. As technology continues to evolve, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our business, improve operations, and make decisions about what's next. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you'll have the opportunity to work across departments, solve meaningful business problems, and help shape how data is transformed into actionable information throughout the organization. If you're looking for a role where you can do more than simply produce reports—and instead help people understand and use data to make better decisions—we'd like to hear from you. Apply today to join GVTC as a Business Intelligence Analyst.
